title: Upload playables
content_data:
This guide walks you through the process of uploading playable assets to the TikTok Creative Library and using them in your ad campaigns via the API.

Playables are interactive, HTML5-based creative assets that let users experience a mini-demo or micro-game of an app directly in their TikTok feed. By offering a "try-before-you-buy" experience, playable creatives help pre-qualify your audience and drive high-intent user acquisition.


## Steps
**1. Upload the playable assets.**

Call the [/playable/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-a-playable-creative/v1.3) endpoint to upload your playable assets. Upon upload, the system automatically validates the assets against TikTok's technical specifications.

2. **Check validation and audit status**.

Call the [/playable/validate/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/check-the-status-of-a-playable-creative/v1.3) endpoint to poll the current validation and audit status of your upload. If the initial validation succeeds, the playable asset automatically enter the audit process.

**3. Save to Creative Library.**

Once the status of a playable reaches `VALIDATE_SUCCESS` or `AUDIT_SUCCESS`, call the [/playable/save/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/save-a-playable-creative/v1.3) endpoint to finalize the upload and save the asset to your Creative Library. The response will return a `playable_url`. Save this URL for the next step.

**Note**: While you can save a playable asset at `VALIDATE_SUCCESS`, only playables that have reached the `AUDIT_SUCCESS` status can actually be delivered in active ad campaigns.

**4. Attach to an ad.**

To use the playable in an Upgraded Smart+ Ad, pass the `playable_url` to the `playable_list` field when calling the [/smart_plus/ad/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-ad/v1.3) or [/smart_plus/ad/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/update-an-upgraded-smart-ad/v1.3) endpoints.
